/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import os, socket
def connect(label, path):
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX)
    try:
        s.connect(path)
        print(label + "=CONNECTED")
    except OSError as e:
        print(label + "=REFUSED(" + str(e.errno) + ")")
    finally:
        s.close()
def ipc(label, path):
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX)
    try:
        s.bind(path)
        s.listen(1)
        c = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX)
        c.connect(path)
        c.close()
        print(label + "=IPC_OK")
    except OSError as e:
        print(label + "=REFUSED(" + str(e.errno) + ")")
    finally:
        s.close()
